# yaa.ms

> > Russian-language technology publication covering AI, machine learning, and tech industry news with comprehensive terminology dictionary

yaa.ms provides in-depth coverage of artificial intelligence developments, neural networks, and technology business news, with particular focus on OpenAI, ChatGPT, and enterprise AI applications. The site features an extensive AI terminology dictionary explaining technical concepts in Russian.

## Key Topics

- OpenAI and ChatGPT
- Neural Networks and Deep Learning
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Machine Learning Models (BERT, GPT, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting)
- Computer Vision (CNN, CLIP)
- Tokenization and Token Processing
- Multimodal AI and Fusion Models
- AI Safety and Content Filtering
- Synthetic Media and Deepfakes
- Enterprise AI Applications
- Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN)
- Attention Mechanisms
- Ensemble Methods
- AI-Generated Content

## AI Terminology Dictionary

- [Что такое Фейк-контент (Fake content), определение термина](https://yaa.ms/dictionary/fejk-kontent): AI-generated content (text, images, video) appearing realistic but false
- [Что такое Промпт-фильтрация (Prompt filtering), определение термина](https://yaa.ms/dictionary/prompt-filtratsiya): Process analyzing and filtering LLM prompts for safety and correctness
- [Что такое Фьюжн-модель (Fusion Model), определение термина](https://yaa.ms/dictionary/fyuzhn-model): Neural network architecture combining models (Random Forest, CNN, RNN)
- [Что такое Ток-энкодинг (Token encoding), определение термина](https://yaa.ms/dictionary/tok-enkoding): Converting text tokens to numerical vectors for neural network processing
- [Что такое Ток-селекция (Token Selection), определение термина](https://yaa.ms/dictionary/tok-selektsiya): Selecting relevant tokens from input for neural network processing (NLP)
